title: Grúas Alhambra takes delivery of Spain’s first Grove GMK6450-1
summary: Granada-based crane rental company selected the GMK6450-1 for its compact dimensions and class-leading lifting performance.The new 450 t capacity all-terrain crane went straight to work supporting wind turbine maintenance.The fully equipped Grove GMK6450-1 features a 79 m luffing jib, MegaWingLift™, and accessories specifically suited to wind energy applications.
body_markdown:
- Granada-based crane rental company selected the GMK6450-1 for its compact dimensions and class-leading lifting performance.
- The new 450 t capacity all-terrain crane went straight to work supporting wind turbine maintenance.
- The fully equipped Grove GMK6450-1 features a 79 m luffing jib, MegaWingLift™, and accessories specifically suited to wind energy applications.


Crane rental company[Grúas Alhambra](https://gruasalhambra.com/) has taken delivery of Spain’s first GMK6450-1, adding Grove’s strongest heavy-duty six-axle all-terrain crane to its fleet. Soon after its arrival, the 450 t capacity crane went straight to work on a wind turbine maintenance project.


Based in Granada, the rental company selected the GMK6450-1 for its compact dimensions and outstanding load charts, which enable it to take on work that would typically require larger seven- or eight-axle models. This combination of strength and compact dimensions is particularly valuable for demanding projects across Andalusia.


“The GMK6450-1 gives us considerably more lifting capacity in a compact six-axle package, which is important for the type of work we carry out across the region”, says Abraham Molina, CEO of Grúas Alhambra. “We’ve been working with Grove cranes for many years and know the products very well. The GMK6450-1 gives us the technology, reach, and versatility we need, while building on the capabilities of the other Grove cranes in our fleet”.


Grúas Alhambra specified its new GMK6450-1 with the 79 m luffing jib, self-rigging MegaWingLift™ capacity-enhancing attachment, and accessories specifically designed for wind energy projects. The MegaWingLift™ increases lifting capacity by up to 70% on the main boom and by up to 400% when using the luffing jib. The attachment is particularly effective at steep angles, making it ideal for wind power projects and other applications requiring heavy loads to be lifted with the boom positioned near vertical.


With MegaWingLift™, the GMK6450-1 can lift 64 t on its 60 m main boom. Fully equipped with the luffing jib and MegaWingLift™, the crane lifts 8.9 t at a 50 m radius and reaches heights of up to 133 m, delivering the reach and performance required for the most demanding projects. It can lift in wind speeds of up to 9 m/s with its 79 m luffing jib.


Its improved hydraulic system delivers increased flow for faster operating speeds and smoother movements. The crane also features MAXbase™ variable outrigger positioning, which allows asymmetrical outrigger setups to improve load charts and optimize performance where space is restricted.
